record.question: Russian President Valdimir Putin signed a decree on 7th August 2014 on banning or limiting the imports of
record.explanation: Answer B: Agricultural products. The August 2014 Russian embargo broadly covered specified agricultural products, raw materials and foodstuffs from selected countries. B is the best description of the decree's category; milk powder is only one narrower product within the implementing list. The source misdates the presidential decree: it was signed on 6 August; the government's implementing decision was 7 August. Historical/source note: Historical 2014 embargo. Presidential decree: 6 August; implementing decision: 7 August. Agricultural products is the overarching category, not every import from all countries. Reference: https://food.ec.europa.eu/horizontal-topics/international-affairs/eu-russia-sps-issues/russian-import-ban-eu-products_en. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
